_why.day.TRAIL_MINUTES: 18 min joins the bus corridors into thin lines and cuts strobe 0.0035 to 0.0034; no fusing downtown
_why.day.BUS_CORE_R: 1.6 px dots stay sharp points on a phone and cut strobe 0.0034 to 0.0020; 2.2 px clumps downtown
_why.BASE_ROADS_GAIN: 0.75 keeps roads visible after the round trip but quieter, so Rapid red and Orange Line stand off the sodium grid
_why.TIME_WARP_GAMMA: 1.5 makes both rushes slower than midday on the clock and cuts peak strobe 0.0021 to 0.0020; night no jumpier
_why.rush.TRAIL_MINUTES: 9 min turns the rush bus lines into thin continuous corridors and lowers strobe 0.00286 to 0.00281
_why.rush.PANEL_ALPHA: 1.15 lifts the credit over the San Ysidro strip from 4.55 to 5.11 contrast; the backdrop still looks the same
